name: tony-football-max
description: A polished 6v6 mini football game that runs in the browser.

scripts.test:syntax: npm run prepare:ton80-game && node --check browser-entry.js && node --check generated/game.js && node --check scripts/dev-server.mjs
scripts.test:workflow-policy: node scripts/enforce-workflow-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-write-github-script-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-local-action-yaml-safety.mjs && node scripts/check-action-pinning-policy.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:intro: npm run prepare:ton80-game && playwright test tests/e2e/match-intro.spec.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:goal: npm run prepare:ton80-game && playwright test tests/e2e/goal-presentation.spec.mjs
scripts.test:preflight: npm run test:ci:fast && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:engine:fast: node --test tests/simulation/*.test.mjs tests/engine/*.test.mjs tests/gameplay/*.test.mjs tests/input/*.test.mjs tests/application/*.test.mjs tests/scenarios/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:ci:fast: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:assets && npm run test:engine:fast && npm run test:presentation:fast && npm run test:tooling && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run prepare:ton80-game && playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.mjs tests/e2e/context-restore.spec.mjs
